image_description: A low-angle shot of two yellow traffic light units mounted on a gray metal pole against an overcast sky. The left unit is a standard vertical three-light signal with dark visors; the right unit appears to be a pedestrian or auxiliary signal, currently showing a green/teal light at the top. The housing is yellow/orange rather than the standard black/dark gray. Trees are visible in the background.
